table.retrieve:
SELECT patient = (SELECT name FROM patient WHERE patientcode = :ai_patientcode ),
		 regno = (SELECT regno FROM patient WHERE patientcode = :ai_patientcode ),
		 a.itemname,
		 qty =  ISNULL(SUM (CASE type When 'S' THEN ISNULL(Looseqty,0) END) , 0 ) ,
		 amount = ISNULL(SUM (CASE type When 'S' THEN ISNULL(Amount,0)  END),  0 ) , 
		 srqty =  ISNULL(SUM (CASE type When 'R' THEN ISNULL(Looseqty,0) END) , 0 ) ,
		 sramount = ISNULL(SUM (CASE type When 'R' THEN ISNULL(Amount,0)  END) , 0)
FROM
(
SELECT 
		 type = 'S' ,
       looseqty=saledetail.looseqty,
       amount=( ( saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)),
       itemname=item.name

FROM 	 dbo.saleledger, 
		 dbo.saledetail,    
		 dbo.item 

WHERE  dbo.saleledger.date >= :ad_startdate AND
		 dbo.saleledger.date <= :ad_enddate  AND
		 dbo.saleledger.patientcode = :ai_patientcode AND
		 dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode AND  
		 dbo.saledetail.icode = item.icode 

UNION ALL

SELECT 
		 type = 'R' ,
		 looseqty= srdetail.looseqty,
       amount=( ( srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice ) * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc) )  ) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)),
       itemname = item.name
FROM 	 dbo.srledger, 
		 dbo.srdetail,    
		 dbo.item 
WHERE  dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_startdate AND
		 dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_enddate  AND
		 dbo.srledger.patientcode = :ai_patientcode AND
		 dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode AND  
		 dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode 

) AS A

GROUP BY itemname
